shots.actions: after the lights are cut the factory yard keeps only the low level of the emergency lamps and an extra row of shadows that should not be there appears on the perimeter wall, countable at a glance; steel rods and ammunition are issued to the wall posts, and the fighter walks the wall alone with the shadow blade half drawn and pushed back; a corner readout shows the normalisation readout at 1.3%

shots.lighting_spatial_logic: one cold overhead key over the purification bench with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the welding arc, the twin flame and the fire heads as the only moving light sources, and the emergency lamp as the sole light after the yard lights are cut
